decision_conditions: Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 4 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 5 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 6 - NON-STD	The basement shall only be used for purposes ancillary to the single family house at 20 Grantham Road and shall not be used as a separate unit of living accommodation. The rooms proposed will at no time be converted to habitable rooms.REASON: NON-STD. The basement, by reason of its lack of natural light, is unsuitable as a separate unit of living accommodation, or as habitable rooms, as defined in the Unitary Development Plan.

Condition : 7 - NON-STD	No demolition or construction work shall take place on the site except between the hours of 8am to 6pm on Mondays to Friday, and 9.30am to 12.30pm on Saturdays, and none shall take place on Sundays and public holidays without prior agreement of the Local Planning Authority.REASON: In order to safeguard the amenities of adjoining residential properties.
description: Enlargement of basement and creation of a lightwell to front of house
